Context-aware AI assistant

This demo showcases Algolia's proactive chat experience. The assistant watches what you read, tracks which components interest you, and — when it has enough context — opens a personalized greeting tailored to your browsing pattern and selected persona.

  • Select a persona in the top-right dropdown to engage the agent with a different focus (Designer, Developer, or Product Manager).
  • Browse a few pages, click CTAs, or scroll deep — the concierge agent will notice and proactively offer help.
  • The chat widget always answers from the live Algolia Agent Studio agents, grounded in real Spectrum documentation.
